snippet.title: Closed Beta - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's the Gameplay Trailer of the Beta Version of Avant-Garde: Napoleonic Battles!

Avant-Garde: Napoleonic Battles is a 3D real-time strategy game that immerses players in historically authentic battlefield reconstructions. 

If you enjoy historically accurate, tactical RTS gameplay where every decision has consequences, consider wishlisting the game and following development.

Wishlist on Steam and follow development as we prepare for the upcoming demo.
👉 store.steampowered.com/app/2608900/AvantGarde_Napoleonic_Battles/

Join our Discord community for exclusive content:
👉 discord.gg/x3PFJfbSE3
